messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Sev2 — VPC pool saffron-prod-1 canary traffic: increased 5xx rate (token errors) and 200-800ms p95 latency spike. PD: emma. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/vpc-rollbacks. Page issued.

emma: Picking this up — joining. Can someone paste quick stats?

miguel: I see the spike in the canary shard (canary-3). Error pattern: TokenizeError on response generation, ~28% of canary reqs failing last 5m. CPU/GPU not OOM.

raj: throwing up a quick graph — https://grafana.internal/d/abc/saffron-canary?orgId=1 (short link). p95 tokens/time spiked at 350ms -> 800ms around 20:03 UTC.

sasha: Confirming logs: repeated stacktrace in runtime: 
``` 
2026-03-15T20:02:11Z runtime ERROR tokenization: invalid byte sequence for model-v2-quant
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/runtime/handler.py", line 231, in process_request
    tokens = tokenizer.encode(text)
  File "/opt/models/tokenizer.py", line 88, in encode
    raise TokenizeError('invalid sequence')
TokenizeError: invalid sequence
```

emma: Customer (Saffron) ops alerted — @kate, can you describe impact?

kate (Saffron Ops): Thanks. Our payment reconciliation job (tenant saffron-fin) is failing in canary region. ~30% of jobs erroring end-to-end. This is high priority for our night batch. Please revert or isolate.

paul: Noted. We should isolate saffron-fin traffic from the canary pool and pin to previous artifact. Two quick options: 1) Divert tenant to safe pool (saffron-prod-stable), or 2) Pin saffron-prod-1 to artifact sha256:9f1e2d (last known-good). I recommend both: divert immediate, then pin/rollback the canary.

emma: Agreed. Miguel/Sasha, can you implement diversion first? We'll coordinate a graceful pin after.

miguel: Implementing diversion now. Using routing API: 
```
# divert traffic for tenant saffron-fin to stable pool
redwoodctl routing divert --tenant saffron-fin --from saffron-prod-1 --to saffron-prod-stable --reason "emergency canary diversion"
```

miguel: Done. API returned 202, routing delta applied. Monitoring now.

raj: Seeing immediate drop in errors for saffron-fin (canary shard). Failure rate down to 2% within two minutes. :+1:

kate (Saffron Ops): Confirmed — our batch resumed, errors dropped to baseline. Thank you.

emma: Next step, pin the canary pool artifact to previous known-good and stop staged rollout. We need to prevent further batch flips. Miguel, Sasha — prepare pin.

sasha: Preparing pin. Candidate artifact: sha256:9f1e2d (deployed 2026-03-14 03:10 UTC). Will pin and trigger a controlled restart on canary nodes.

paul: Remember to annotate the action for audit: include ticket id (#INC-2312), customer consent, and timeline.

miguel: Executing pin now: 
```
# pin artifact and stop new rollouts
redwoodctl pool pin --pool saffron-prod-1 --artifact sha256:9f1e2d --reason "emergency rollback after tokenizer errors" --ticket INC-2312
# drain new canary tasks
redwoodctl pool restart --pool saffron-prod-1 --mode graceful
```

miguel: Pin accepted. Restart jobs scheduled. Expect 2-4 min for full rollout to finish on 6 canary nodes.

infra-oncall: Watch disk and cache warming on restart — KV cache flush may increase latencies briefly. Route fallback enabled.

raj: Observing p95 returning toward baseline (250-300ms) as restarts complete. Error rate dropping to ~1%.

emma: Handing off to raj for post-fix monitoring. I'll update Saffron and close PD. Raj, take lead for 2hr watch and postmortem.

raj: Acknowledged. I'll keep the channel open and collect logs. Action items:
- Confirm all saffron tenants running on stable pools (miguel)
- Gather tokenizer error sample set and correlate with model artifact checksum (sasha)
- Postmortem (owner: raj) draft in 24h, include RCA and mitigation (auto-retry on tokenize errors, model validation in rollout).

kate (Saffron Ops): Appreciate the quick response. Please include any prevention we can do on our side for payload encoding checks.

emma: Closing PD to free oncall. We'll keep this thread open for monitoring and postmortem notes. Thanks team. :heart: 

(incident-bot): PD note: Incident acknowledged and marked Mitigated at 2026-03-15T20:35:00Z. Follow-up task created INC-2312.

raj: Final note — no engine level OOM, root cause looks tied to a tokenizer change in model-v2-quant build pipeline. Sasha will confirm if packaging step introduced an invalid byte sequence for specific unicode inputs.
